## RE:volution Mod v1.2.3

### Added
- Added configurable duplicate compensation for rune status 1 (Poison).
- Poison rune duplicates now grant `rune_dust`, with a default value of 10 per duplicate.
- Added configurable duplicate-compensation calculation modes: `FIXED`, `BY_RANK`, and `FORMULA`.
- Added event multipliers that modify the base compensation calculation without replacing it.
- Added regression coverage for rune duplicate-compensation configuration.

### Fixed
- Duplicate rune attempts now grant the configured resource instead of only being counted in purchase output.
- Rune-resource balances are refreshed for the client after purchases that produce duplicates.

### Other
- Duplicate compensation is calculated and applied server-side and persists through the existing resource system.
- Manual in-game runtime validation and feature/develop/main CI validation were completed before release preparation.
- Updated the mod version metadata to `1.2.3`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.3.jar`.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.2...v1.2.3](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.2...v1.2.3)
